V3 · SHOT 25 — MACRO: FILLING THE SHOT

svg.text: Macro on two form fields, huge and soft-edged: "Describe the shot" → "Our serum
bottle, in a hand, on wet marble"; "Length" → "10 s".
Fields slide up as the camera tracks down the form; text types in. Shallow depth of
field, background washed teal. Ref: "Workflow Name (Button Label)" macro.

g.text: V3 · SHOT 26 — FOUR TAKES, KEEP ONE

svg.text: Glass panel with four generated takes in a 2×2. One gets a teal outline and a "Keep"
Takes resolve from soft noise to sharp, 60 ms stagger. Cursor clicks Keep; the chosen
Kept take flips into a vertical UGC ad.

V3 · SHOT 27 — UGC AD, STEP BY STEP

svg.text: The kept take is now inside a vertical ad on the left. Right: numbered steps like a
builder: 1 HOOK "I was so wrong about serums" · 2 DEMO "30 seconds, morning light" · 3
PAYOFF "okay this actually worked". Coral tags.
Steps build one at a time over 5 s (about 1.5 s each, like the reference's workflow
builder), with a connecting line drawing down. Ref: Numtera's numbered workflow steps

V3 · SHOT 28 — ONE EDIT, NINE VOICES

svg.text: A single player centre-frame; a vertical list of the nine languages beside it with the
selection stepping EN → DE → FR. The waveform under the player reshapes each time.
Selection steps on each beat; waveform morphs; picture never moves. Small chip:
"And upload it nine times, not once."
The same phrase in three languages, crossfading.
Pull back into white: the summary line.
